description: The experimental pressurised suit (Grissom Suit) suffered a torn air hose, snagged on a sharp ATV rail edge during transit on EVA 01.
response: In-field repair: the torn segment was cut out, the hose patched, and pressure-tested. The suit held and the EVA continued.
lesson: Route and secure all air hoses away from ATV metal edges before departure. Carry duct tape and a hose repair kit in suit pockets on every EVA.
pattern_tag: suit hose routing near ATV sharp edges
